description: Defines a utility enum 'WebViewJavaScriptSupport' with static functions to interact with WKWebView via JavaScript, including applying debug status and evaluating JavaScript expressions.

methods.name: applyDebugStatus
methods.description: Injects JavaScript into the web view to set debug status and optional title/subtitle using a JS API if available.

methods.name: evaluateToString
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript string asynchronously in the web view, returning the result as a String.

methods.name: jsValue
methods.description: Converts a Swift String? into a JavaScript-compatible string literal, handling nulls and JSON encoding.
